payload.title: hydroponics-service resolvers gate every query and mutation with @Roles(MODULE_USER), which every account role satisfies, so any member of any tenant reads and creates hydroponics configurations and any global MODULE_MANAGER deletes them, with no hydroponics module decision

apps/hydroponics-service/src/setup/resolvers/setup.resolver.ts:49 (list requires @Roles(Role.MODULE_USER); so do create :97, update :117 and delete :150)
libs/backend-common/src/decorators/roles.decorator.ts:82 (role hierarchy: every account role satisfies MODULE_USER, :82-87)
apps/hydroponics-service/src/setup/resolvers/setup.resolver.ts:172 (any MODULE_MANAGER, TENANT_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN may delete any configuration)

payload.rule_violated: D3 (hydroponics is reserved and only gated) and D2: hydroponics-private nutrient configuration is reachable only with a hydroponics grant.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-12, release R5.
